Power the Pacific Northwest: Shape the Future of Clean Energy as our Internal Operations Leader The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is at the heart of the Pacific Northwest's clean energy lifeline, operating one of the nation's largest and most reliable high-voltage transmission grids.

Behind the physical lines and substations that power millions of homes and businesses is a dedicated engine of operational excellence. As the Internal Operations Manager, you will step into a pivotal, high-visibility role as the operational "chief of staff" for our Construction and Maintenance Services division.

You will lead the critical planning, budgeting, and administrative strategies that empower our field crews to execute grid-modernization projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

If you are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of team leadership, resource optimization, and high-impact project support, this is your opportunity to drive real-world impact on the future of clean energy.

Key Responsibilities of the Role Here are the eight most impactful and rewarding duties of this position, redesigned to highlight your strategic influence and leadership impact: Serve as a Chief Strategic Advisor Directly partner with senior executive leadership to shape, implement, and evaluate regional grid construction and maintenance programs.

In this trusted advisory role, you will provide critical data, analytical insights, and strategic recommendations that influence high-level decision-making. Lead, Mentor, and Empower a High-Performing Team Provide direct leadership and oversight to a talented team of professional and administrative experts.

You will establish performance standards, foster professional growth, resolve workplace disputes, and champion a collaborative, inclusive culture built on mutual respect and shared success. Drive Multi-Million-Dollar Portfolio and Budget Planning Take ownership of long-range program planning, budgeting, and workload scheduling.

You will oversee resource allocations and monitor third-party contractor portfolios to ensure critical infrastructure projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Build and Navigate Key Stakeholder Alliances Represent the agency in critical negotiations and collaborative efforts with executive leaders, federal and state partners, regional public and private utility providers, and manufacturing representatives. You will serve as a key broker in aligning regional interests and securing essential resources.

Champion Process Innovation and Efficiency Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks. You will foster a forward-thinking, cost-conscious, and results-oriented environment by designing and implementing modern, streamlined workflows that continuously improve operational delivery.

Navigate Regulatory Compliance and Grid Modernization Interpret and apply national energy guidelines and utility performance standards (including NERC and FERC regulations). You will ensure that all planning, construction, and asset-management initiatives align with national compliance frameworks to protect grid reliability.

Shape Long-Term Workforce and Contract Strategies Determine long-range staffing requirements and make high-level decisions on whether to leverage internal personnel or contract work out to private partners. You will design annual and long-range strategic work plans that align administrative resources with field operations.

Champion Safety and Field Readiness Oversee and coordinate critical technical craft and safety training programs across the Pacific Northwest. You will ensure that field personnel are fully equipped, certified, and compliant with safety standards to successfully execute high-risk construction projects.
SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level [GS-12] in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: 1) Providing program management and analytical advisory services to management in the areas of work planning, scheduling, budgeting, and cost analysis within a utility, construction, production, or maintenance organization; and 2) Performing lead or supervisory duties such as planning and assigning work, establishing performance standards, and resolving administrative or employee grievances.

"Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Time-in-Grade: Current Federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement to receive consideration. CTAP/ICTAP candidates: To be considered "well qualified" you must meet all of the requirements as described in this section.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

A day in the life: The AI Operations Manager is the operating system behind the Innovation team. You administer the company's enterprise AI platforms, keep the SVP and the team's initiatives moving in sync, keep the roadmap current, and act as an early-warning system for what is changing at the AI frontier.

Early on the work is operations-heavy; your strategic voice is expected to grow as you automate the operations down. You are a force multiplier, not a support function.

Responsibilities: - Administer the company's enterprise AI platforms - Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, and new tools as we adopt them - covering provisioning, access, RBAC, usage governance, and billing, and automate that administration down over time. - Keep the SVP of Innovation organized and ahead of schedule through prioritization, prep, and follow-through - you catch what would otherwise slip before it does. - Run the Innovation team's weekly operating rhythm and keep the roadmap current and trusted at all times. - Produce a weekly AI intelligence brief on what is shipping at the frontier and what the team should test. - Bring a point of view into strategy conversations and grow into a genuine strategic voice for the team. - Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department. - Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements: 2-4 years of experience; early-career with an unusually high ceiling and a fast learning rate. AI-native - you use Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini daily and have real intuition for what they can and cannot do. This is the non-negotiable bar. A strong organizer who makes chaos legible and closes loops without being chased.

A clear writer and systems thinker who holds a point of view. Comfortable being the least experienced person in the room and still adding value. Meaningful daily overlap with U.S. Pacific hours (LATAM timezones ideal); remote, open to international candidates. Bonus: you have built something with AI - an agent, a workflow, or a shipped side project.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - Enterprise AI platform access and provisioning requests resolved within one business day, fully documented. - Admin time trending down quarter over quarter as workflows get automated. - Weekly AI intelligence brief shipped on time, every week. - Roadmap accurate and current at any given moment - never a scramble to update it. - Zero missed commitments or dropped follow-ups traceable to coordination gaps.

Most Important Things (MITs) - Be the reason the Innovation team's operations run without friction. - Keep the SVP focused on the highest-leverage work by owning everything beneath it. - Turn AI platform administration into a system that mostly runs itself. - Act as an early-warning system for what is changing in AI - surface it before it is obvious. - Earn a real voice in strategy by being right, useful, and fast.

The Bureau of Human Resources proposes a structured, project-based student volunteer initiative within the Records and Information Management branch of the Office of Talent Services (HR/TS/RIM) at the U.S. Department of State.

This initiative directly supports the Presidential Management Agenda and Department priorities related to standardizing systems, eliminating data silos, and reducing wasteful processes.

Student volunteers will contribute to clearly defined, outcome-driven projects, including the documentation of standard procedures, conducting process mapping and proposing innovative modernizations, and updating SharePoint and ServiceNow systems with relevant information.

These efforts address a legitimate agency need to increase efficiencies as well as improve the usability, discoverability, and preservation of operational documents while supporting broader federal data and records management objectives.

The project is designed to align with student learning objectives by providing hands-on experience in process mapping and improvement, writing in Plain Language, lean management practices, and digital records management, while strengthening technical, analytical, and critical thinking skills.

Work will be scoped for completion within a single academic term and will include structured milestones such as onboarding and training, midpoint progress reviews, and final deliverables.

Deliverables may include process documentation, digitized Standard Operating Procedures cataloged in web-based systems, and research summaries that can be operationalized by HR/TS/RIM staff.

Goal: Improve the clarity, consistency, and efficiency of HR/TS/RIM's standard operating procedures (SOPs) by reviewing, revising, and standardizing up to 10 priority SOP documents using Lean management principles, Plain Language best practices, and staff input.

Objectives: 1) By the end of the Spring 2027 semester, review up to 10 existing SOPs; consult with relevant staff and partners to identify process inefficiencies, lessons learned, and opportunities for improvement; research and apply appropriate Lean management principles to develop revised SOP draft. 2) By the end of the Spring 2027 semester, create a culminating presentation to HR/TS/RIM staff and leadership about insights and lessons learned from SOP review, including any recommendations for additional improvements and practice adoptions for the office gleaned from interactions with staff and reviewing source materials.

Deliverables: By the conclusion of the internship, finalize and upload all approved SOPs to the designated digital platform using the organization's standard template, ensuring each document is written in Plain Language, reflects current practices, and is organized for ease of use and future maintenance.
Applicants will be considered based on their knowledge, skills or abilities related to project needs.

Specifically, applicants should possess: - Strong attention to detail - Research capabilities - Interest in management, process development, and digital records management Preferred qualifications: - Students pursuing degrees in business, public administration, communications, or related fields - Familiarity with process documentation and management practices - Familiarity with Microsoft 365 tools (e.g., Excel, SharePoint)

About GENUINE
GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend.
To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment.
The Mission
You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid.
You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability.
Aufgaben

Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements.
Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions.
You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital.
Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software
Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share).
Qualifikation
Your Profile
Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus.
Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel.
Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD.
Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.).

What’s In It For You
Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands.
A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed.
Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects.
The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee).
Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry.
Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere.
We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you.

GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai.

There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops.
